headline: Baltic Dry Index Rises to Near Two-Month Peak on Broad Gains
summary: The Baltic Exchange’s dry bulk freight index rose 1.3% to 3,107 points, marking its highest level since October 2 with broad-based gains across vessel segments.
why: Dry bulk freight rates serve as a primary macroeconomic indicator for global raw material demand and maritime shipping sector health.

impacts.name: Baltic Dry Index
impacts.why: Increased charter rates across vessel segments elevate the dry bulk freight benchmark.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stronger demand for shipping raw materials across vessel classes drove higher charter rates.
